notes.title: Big update of june
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Interface:[/b][/h1]
The interface has been redesigned to make it more intuitive and user-friendly. All important information has been grouped around the map in the bottom left corner of the screen. This is also where the player can access the buttons to manage their fort and army.

[h1][b]Economy:[/b][/h1]
Resources have been removed from the game to simplify and clarify gameplay. Now, there is only one resource to monitor: "Prestige." This resource is earned by completing missions and eliminating waves of enemies. It allows the player to upgrade their fort and recruit soldiers.

[h1][b]Construction System:[/b][/h1]
Instead of building structures one by one in predefined locations, the player can now purchase entire fort upgrades from the construction menu. For example, the player can buy the barricade upgrade and see all the barricades appear at once.

[h1][b]New Units:[/b][/h1]
Two new units have been introduced. The player can now recruit "the Brute," a soldier equipped with a shotgun, more resistant to gunfire, and capable of dealing damage to multiple enemies at once. He is particularly effective at close range. The second unit is the Sniper, capable of eliminating enemies with a single shot from a long distance, though he is very vulnerable to attacks.

[h1][b]Captain's Power:[/b][/h1]
The captain's special attack has been revised. Its range is now shorter, and it can target a maximum of 6 enemies per use. The power recharge has also been adjusted. It recharges much more slowly but does not discharge as quickly, giving the player more time to think and use the power at the right moment.
